mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN department.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept ancestor WHERE FIND_IN_SET(ancestor.id, department.ancestors) AND (ancestor.deleted != 0 OR ancestor.status = 1) ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM sys_dept department WHERE department.id = #{id} AND department.deleted = 0

SELECT department.id FROM sys_dept department WHERE (department.id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, department.ancestors)) AND department.deleted = 0 AND department.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept ancestor WHERE FIND_IN_SET(ancestor.id, department.ancestors) AND (ancestor.deleted != 0 OR ancestor.status = 1) )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET ancestors = CONCAT(#{et.ancestors}, ',', #{et.id}, SUBSTRING(ancestors, CHAR_LENGTH(#{previousPath}) + 1)), update_by = #{et.updateBy}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE deleted = 0 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{et.id}, ancestors)
